name: Homeland Interactive Technology Ltd.
summary: Homeland Interactive Technology Ltd., an investment holding company, engages in the development, publication, and operation of localized mobile card and board games in the People's Republic of China. The company offers mahjong, poker, and casual games. It also offers software development and technical services. Homeland Interactive Technology Ltd. was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, the People's Republic of China.
